description: This file defines the CalendarCacheWrapper class which implements calendar-related operations, including fetching availability data with cache optimization, managing calendar events, and delegating calls to an underlying calendar implementation.

classes.name: CalendarCacheWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing calendar operations with caching and delegation to an original calendar implementation.

methods.name: getCredentialId
methods.description: Returns the credential ID from the original calendar or -1 if not available.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event via the original calendar.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event via the original calendar.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event via the original calendar.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches combined availability data from cache and original calendar sources.

methods.name: getAvailabilityWithTimeZones
methods.description: Fetches availability data with time zones, combining cache and original sources.

methods.name: fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache
methods.description: Fetches availability and updates cache, delegated to the original calendar if available.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists available calendars, delegated to the original calendar.

methods.name: testDelegationCredentialSetup
methods.description: Tests delegation credential setup, delegated to the original calendar.
